summary: HelmCharts' gen-architecture now publishes an interface for every in-cluster Service and links each interface to its non-init instances. Hosts resolve through the published set the way aac-tools does it: Dataset, resolve_host, serving, publish_service_interfaces and resolve_boundby are AST-identical to ArgoCDTools 7806d46 (commits a8f0bbb, 16d1af6 on phase/025-P2, not pushed). Witnessed live: rendering jenkins and postgres-pas with both generators gives equal ids, fields and relations; HelmCharts stays green without them and draws their 4 edges with the same ids; the full render passes arch-validate. Gate green at 40 generator tests.
